title: SearchMate rated record, rounds 26–109
rating_definition: Official rules say the live rating is fitted to the current build. The displayed historical series and cumulative result totals span submissions; this is not a fixed-engine Elo series.
limitations: No per-game source hashes; build groups follow user submission history, with explicit uncertain boundaries.
Round 30 is dashboard-void; its historical exported draw is preserved but excluded from scored totals.
Round 80 is unassigned between v14 and v16.1. Round 106 is unassigned.
Round 105 has a supplied runtime log but no supplied PGN. Public-only observations are not replay-verified.
This frozen publication cutoff contains ladder games, not final Swiss results.
Historical result reports are evidence snapshots; no new engine workloads ran for this compilation.
